card.name: First letter of a split medical term
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical or brand term that is split up, often a lone capital letter such as T or R. It sits at the start of a warning item, brand name or syndrome name, e.g. Tumor lysis, TEN, Rolvedon.

modes.label: Start of warning term
modes.description: A single capital T or R opens a syndrome or reaction name after a bullet or list break.

modes.label: Start of brand or drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a brand or drug name such as Rolvedon, Rybrevant or Hydrochloride.

modes.label: Word before healthcare professional
modes.description: The word qualified in the advice to consult a healthcare professional.
modes.example: should consult with a<< qualified>> healthcare professional.

card.writes: No clear link; the promoted tokens (random, topical, treatments) are mixed and the pole's effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter or piece of a long medical or brand name that the model has split up.
